attention_scope: 10 prompts x 30 layers; standard RoPE + camera PRoPE; joint K_and_V intervention
compression_accounting: joint BF16 K+V bytes / per-prompt cache payload; C64 RVQ indices are bit-packed at 6 bits/index; RVQ codebooks and specialized decoder tables are shared model parameters and excluded from the per-prompt KV-cache payload

method_semantics.+ RVQ: adaptive RVQ plus the same uniform specialized encoder on the residual
method_semantics.Adaptive routing: adaptive RVQ plus specialized encoder and frozen layer-head adaptive routing
method_semantics.Direct: uniform RVQ-specialized K/V encoder applied directly to raw KV

reconstruction_scope: 10 prompts x 30 layers x 10 independent 3520-token chunks; pre-RoPE/pre-PRoPE D128 BF16; element-weighted K/V MSE
